title: Well..looks great
text: Well..looks great. Bought to match kitchen counter but there is no drain area for liquid to flow from wet/drying dishes into the kitchen sink. Looks great except for the water pooled in undertray when used.

product_metadata.title: iDesign Forma Lupe Stainless Steel Metal Sink Dish Drainer Plastic Tray Kitchen Drying Rack For Glasses, Silverware, Bowls, Plates, 13.3" x 17.5" x 5.2", Bronze
features: DRYING RACK: Stainless steel dish rack and plastic tray allow plates, cups, mugs, forks, knives, spoons, and other cutlery to air dry while also keeping the counter free of water as drips are caught by the tray. Dry dishes anywhere on the counter, not just next to the sink
WATERPROOF: 100% waterproof tray will not leak onto your countertops
DURABLE: Made of durable amber plastic and stainless steel with a bronze finish for years of quality use
EASY CARE: Rack removes easily to make cleaning and draining hassle-free
IDEAL SIZE: Dish rack measures 13.3" x 17.5" x 5.2", perfect for your kitchen counter
description: Make the most of your kitchen space with the iDesign's Forma Lupe Sink Dish Drainer! This quality stainless steel dish rack can be placed anywhere on the counter, not just by the sink. The metal rack removes easily from the amber plastic tray for hassle-free draining and cleaning. The removable rack holds 15 dishes and sits neatly in the closed-bottom tray. The cutlery tray holds all your silverware, spatulas, and wooden spoons separately. Made with durable plastic and rust-resistant stainless steel with a bronze finish, this drying rack has a 100% waterproof bottom tray for your convenience. Measuring 13.3" x 17.5" x 5.2", the iDesign Forma Lupe Sink Dish Drainer is the answer to your organizational needs! With iDesign by InterDesign, you can #LiveSimply every day.
